description:
This map displays the geographic partitioning of Europe into 38 distinct operational areas, referred to as "Production-unit codes." The covered area includes the European continent, the British Isles, Fennoscandia, and associated islands in the Atlantic Ocean, Norwegian Sea, Barents Sea, Baltic Sea, Black Sea, and Mediterranean Sea.

Each production unit is labelled with a unique "DU" code:
DU0001, DU0002, DU0004, DU0005, DU0006, DU0007, DU0008, DU0009, DU0010, DU0011, DU0012, DU0013, DU0014, DU0015, DU0016, DU0017, DU0018, DU0019, DU0020, DU0021, DU0022, DU0023 (appears in Central Europe and near Greece), DU0024, DU0025, DU0026, DU0027 (Atlantic islands including Azores, Madeira, Canaries), DU0028, DU0029, DU0030, DU0031 (appears in the Aegean Sea and the Turkish Black Sea coast), DU0032, DU0033, DU0034, DU0035, DU0036, DU0037, DU0038.

Land areas are shaded light grey with black outlines for the production units, while water bodies are light blue. A compass rose indicates North. A scale bar shows distances ranging from 0 to 1,500 km. These production units are likely used for data processing, validation, or product generation within the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) framework, particularly for tasks involving Sentinel-2 super-resolution or Very High Resolution (VHR) imagery analysis.
